key_insight: APEX-SWE is a benchmark that evaluates whether frontier AI models can perform economically valuable, end-to-end software engineering work, focusing on real-world integration across heterogeneous cloud services and business applications. It shifts evaluation from narrow micro-tasks to practical, execution-oriented SWE outcomes.
problem_solved: Current model evaluations emphasize well-defined, narrow tasks that don't reflect the complexity and economic stakes of real software engineering; APEX-SWE fills this gap by measuring models on realistic, high-value engineering workflows.
method: Design a benchmark (APEX-SWE) centered on real-world SWE activities, including a suite of integration tasks (n=100) that require building end-to-end systems across cloud primitives, business applications, and infrastructure.
Evaluate frontier AI models on their ability to execute, integrate, and deliver functionally correct end-to-end solutions with an emphasis on economic value (time/cost/automation potential).
Use outcome-focused metrics (execution success, correctness, and economic impact) rather than only isolated subtask scores to assess practical utility.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners and engineering leaders a practical yardstick for choosing and deploying models that can automate high-value software engineering work, helping prioritize investments and measure ROI on AI-enabled engineering automation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing benchmark flow: task specification → model execution → end-to-end system verification → economic impact assessment
